coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting the nine ground-truth variable categories equally, three match semantically: target properties (p-logP, QED, and binding affinity), model configurations (pretrained prior, baseline, and feedback-optimized agent), and structural diversity, including long-carbon-chain measurements. This gives 3/9 = 33%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the fixed MOLGEN pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration, the synthetic versus natural-product domain comparison, top-three property-score reporting, and the specified binding-affinity improvements. Only ESR1 matches the target list; ACAA1 is replaced by EGFR and BACE1. It substitutes an extensive distribution-alignment and artifact-penalization experiment for the specified MOLGEN evaluation.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports exceptionally high p-logP scores up to 80.30, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% ESR1 and 70.4% ACAA1 improvements, or reduced hallucinations with maintained molecular diversity.
